purpose: Core application context: owns the tray icon, context menu, and 5-second polling loop that evaluates idle+CPU conditions and launches the configured target app.
called_by: Program.cs — instantiated and passed to Application.Run
calls_out_to: PhysicalIdle.Start / Stop / GetIdleMilliseconds / TryRepairHooksIfNeeded — idle tracking
invariants: Armed/disarmed state: disarms after any automatic launch failure; re-arms only when fresh physical input is detected
WorkstationLock is only applied for idle-triggered launches, never for manual Run Now
gotchas: _launchingSerialized and _shutDownSerialized are Interlocked flags preventing re-entrant launches and double-shutdown
LaunchEvaluation.StateKey is used to debounce tooltip updates — only redrawn when the readiness state actually changes
Screensaver (.scr) targets automatically receive /s prepended to arguments to start full-screen mode
Custom tray icon is loaded from AppPaths.TrayIconFile; on load failure the default embedded icon is used silently
